channel.title: Daily AI News
channel.description: Twice-daily AI news briefing produced by the daily-ai-news Copilot skill.

item.title: Google I/O 2026: Gemini Omni Debuts — 100 AI Announcements Drop
item.description: Google's most AI-saturated developer conference ever kicked off today, unveiling Gemini Omni and a sweeping overhaul of nearly every Google product with AI.

item.title: AI Captures 45% of All VC Deals in May — $25B Disclosed
item.description: AI startups commanded nearly half of all venture capital activity in May 2026, with 37 of 82 tracked deals totaling $25 billion in disclosed funding.

item.title: EU AI Act High-Risk Enforcement Deadline Approaches — August 2026
item.description: With the EU AI Act's August 2026 enforcement date for high-risk AI systems approaching, global compliance pressure is intensifying for AI companies operating in Europe.

item.title: Governments Demand Pre-Release Model Testing — Major Labs Comply
item.description: The US and other governments are now requiring pre-release regulatory testing for new frontier AI models, with OpenAI, Google, and Anthropic agreeing to provide early regulatory access.

item.title: Google I/O 2026: "The Agentic Gemini Era" Begins
item.description: Google CEO Sundar Pichai declared we are "firmly in the agentic Gemini era," unveiling 50+ announcements including new frontier models, a 24/7 personal AI agent, and a major hardware pivot.

item.title: Tencent Launches Marvis: OS-Level AI Assistant
item.description: Tencent released Marvis, a cross-platform AI assistant operating at the OS level with multi-device support and a local privacy mode.

item.title: AI Startup Funding Reaches $25B in May Alone
item.description: May 2026 has already seen 37 disclosed AI funding deals totaling $25B, continuing a record-breaking year for AI venture capital.

item.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Nano Omni: Open-Source Multimodal Powerhouse
item.description: NVIDIA released a fully open-source multimodal model supporting video, audio, image, and text in a single system.

item.title: DeepSeek V4 Series Resets Price-Performance Expectations
item.description: DeepSeek V4-Flash and V4-Pro released as open-weight frontier-class models with dramatically lower API pricing than Western equivalents.

item.title: Adobe Photoshop 27.7: Local AI Gets Double Credits
item.description: Adobe shipped a major AI update to Photoshop, doubling generative AI credits for locally-processed operations and emphasizing hybrid cloud/local processing.

item.title: EU AI Act High-Risk Compliance Deadline Approaching: August 2026
item.description: The EU AI Act's full compliance requirements for high-risk AI systems — used in hiring, credit, healthcare, and law enforcement — take effect in August 2026.

item.title: Agentic AI Triggers Liability Gap Debate in US Congress
item.description: The rise of autonomous AI agents is prompting urgent legal debate in the US about who bears liability when an AI agent causes harm — the user, developer, or deployer.

item.title: OpenAI's reasoning model disproves a 1946 Erdős conjecture in discrete geometry
item.description: OpenAI's new reasoning model autonomously disproved the planar unit distance problem first posed by Paul Erdős in 1946 — being called a milestone in AI mathematics.

item.title: Anthropic posts "biggest week ever": Claude Code Auto Mode, Claude Design, Karpathy hire
item.description: Anthropic ran a barrage of releases this week — Claude Code Auto Mode, a new visual collaboration product called Claude Design, and confirmation that Andrej Karpathy is joining to work on Claude pretraining research.

item.title: DeepWeb-Bench and PALS headline this week's arXiv drops
item.description: A wave of new arXiv papers this week pushes harder benchmarks and more sustainable serving methods for frontier models.

item.title: Evolution Strategies revive as a scalable fine-tuning path for billion-parameter LLMs
item.description: New work shows Evolution Strategies can efficiently fine-tune billion-parameter language models, with measurable gains on math reasoning benchmarks.

item.title: Q1 2026: 80% of global venture funding went to AI
item.description: Crunchbase-style data show AI captured $242B of the $300B in global venture funding in Q1 2026 — up from 55% a year earlier — with four companies absorbing roughly 65% of that total.

item.title: Anthropic and OpenAI both launch Wall Street joint ventures for enterprise AI
item.description: In parallel announcements, Anthropic and OpenAI each unveiled joint ventures with major private equity firms to push AI services into hundreds of midsized companies and PE portfolios.

item.title: Alibaba ships Qwen3.7-Max as a "new agent frontier" model
item.description: Alibaba released Qwen3.7-Max with a deliberate focus on agentic capabilities — autonomous reasoning, tool use, and multi-step task solving.

item.title: OpenAI adopts Google's SynthID watermark for AI-generated images
item.description: OpenAI is adopting Google's SynthID watermarking for AI-generated images and shipping a verification tool to detect AI-created content.

item.title: EU AI Act hits hard-enforcement phase; US considers pre-release model vetting
item.description: The EU AI Act is now in active enforcement for high-risk systems, while the White House is reportedly weighing pre-release vetting for advanced AI models.

item.title: Google I/O 2026: Gemini 3.5 Flash, Spark, and Omni unveiled
item.description: Google used its I/O keynote to roll out a new lightweight flagship model, a personal agent, and a "world model" for physical-world simulation.

item.title: OpenAI reasoning model autonomously solves a 1946 Erdős geometry problem
item.description: OpenAI announced a new reasoning system that independently disproved the planar unit-distance problem posed by Paul Erdős in 1946 — reportedly the first time an AI has autonomously resolved a major open mathematical conjecture.

item.title: Anthropic ships Claude Design, hires Karpathy, signs mega cloud deals
item.description: Anthropic had one of the most consequential weeks of its history, pairing product launches with massive infrastructure deals and a marquee hire.

item.title: Penn researchers demonstrate hybrid light-matter particle for optical AI compute
item.description: A University of Pennsylvania team reported a hybrid light-matter quasiparticle that could enable dramatically faster and more energy-efficient AI computation, suggesting a path for optical processors to replace electronic ones on key AI workloads.

item.title: Anthropic acquires Stainless, cutting off a key dev-tools vendor used by OpenAI and Google
item.description: Anthropic acquired developer-tools startup **Stainless**, reportedly for over $300M. Stainless's SDK and API-automation tech was widely used by OpenAI, Google, and Cloudflare; going forward its core products will be Anthropic-only.

item.title: Anduril closes record $5B Series H at $61B valuation
item.description: AI-defense company **Anduril** closed a $5B Series H at a $61B valuation — the largest venture round ever in defense tech — to scale manufacturing of autonomous drones, weapons, and naval systems.

item.title: Pre-release model testing becomes a global norm as enforcement era begins
item.description: Multiple major governments are now requiring pre-release testing and transparency disclosures for frontier AI models, marking a clear shift from voluntary guidelines to active enforcement.

item.title: Google I/O 2026: Gemini Omni, Gemini 3.5 Flash, and Agentic-First Stack Unveiled
item.description: Google used I/O 2026 to roll out two new flagship Gemini models and reorganize its product line around autonomous agents.

item.title: KPMG to Deploy Anthropic's Claude Across Global Tax and Advisory, Training 30,000 Staff
item.description: KPMG will embed Claude into its global tax and advisory platform and stand up a joint Center of Excellence with Anthropic.

item.title: arXiv Imposes One-Year Ban on Authors Who Let LLMs Write Entire Papers
item.description: arXiv's computer science section will ban authors for a year if a submission contains "incontrovertible evidence" the authors did not check LLM-generated content.

item.title: Mercury Hits $5.2B Valuation on $200M Series D as "Bank for AI Startups"
item.description: AI-startup-focused digital bank Mercury raised a $200M Series D led by TCV, lifting its valuation 49% to $5.2B.

item.title: Exa Raises $250M Series C at $2.2B Valuation to Build "Search Engine for AI Agents"
item.description: AI-native search infrastructure company Exa closed a $250M Series C to scale models and infrastructure designed for autonomous agent queries.

item.title: Google Ships Antigravity 2.0 with Desktop App, CLI, SDK, and Voice Control
item.description: Google launched Antigravity 2.0 at I/O 2026, expanding its agentic coding platform with a redesigned desktop app, a new CLI, and an SDK for custom agents.

item.title: EU AI Act's August 2, 2026 Enforcement Deadline Looms, Most Enterprises Unprepared
item.description: With roughly ten weeks to go, analysts warn that the bulk of EU AI Act obligations for high-risk systems will become enforceable on August 2, 2026, while most enterprises lack basic AI inventories.
